paite: Huan ni sawtkuamtak nung in hichi ahong hi a, akum thum kum in TOUPA thu Elijah kiang ah ahong tung hi. "Va kuan inla, Ahab kiang ah va kihil in. Huchi in leitung ah vuah ka zusak ding," achi hi.
heading: Elijah Leh Baal Siampute

paite: Ahab kiang a kihil ding in Elijah akuanta hi. Samaria gam ah kial ana mahmah hi.
Ahab in Obadiah, a-inn sunglam heutu asam hi. Obadiah bel TOUPA laudan siam mahmah mi ahi a;
huan, hichi ahong hi a, Jezebel in TOUPA zawlneite asatkhiak lai in Obadiah in zawlnei zakhat api a, kokhuk ah sawmnga nga in asel a, tanghou leh tui in avak hi.

Ahab in Obadiah kiang ah, "Tui nak nei tengteng leh lui phaizang tengteng omna gam va tuan vialvial dih ve. Sakol leh sabiltungte i hut hing theihna ding in loupa i muhsak thei kha hiam, huchi lou in zaw gante i tan vek kha ding,” achi hi.
Huchi in gam totsuak ding in akihawm ua; Ahab amah kia in lampi dang ah apai a, Obadiah leng amah kia in lampi dang ah apai hi.
Huchi a Obadiah apai lai in, ngai in, Elijah in ana tuak a; ama'n athei lai a, huchi in abokkhup a, "Ka toupa Elijah na hi maw?" achi hi.
Ama'n adawng a, "Hi e, kuan inla, ngai in, Elijah huai ah a-om hi, chi in na toupa va hilh in,” achi hi.
Ama'n, "Thil bang ahia ka hihkhelh a, na sikha thah dia Ahab khut a na hon piak ding?
TOUPA na Pathian ahin bang in ka gen ahi, ka pu in nang ahon zonsaklouhna nam leh gam himhim a-om kei. Hiai ah a-om kei, achih chiang un nang ahon muhlouhna thu uah gam leh nam akichiamsak hi.
Tu in nang, kuan inla, ngai in, Elijah hiai ah a-om, chi in na toupa va hilh in, na chi hi.

Huan hichi ahi ding a, nang ka hon nutsiattak in TOUPA Kha in ka theihlouhna ah nang ahong lamang dia; huchi in Ahab ka va hilh a, nang ahon muh theih ngal ke'n zaw, kei hon that mai ding hi. Himahleh na sikha in ka valnou tung a pan TOUPA ka lau hi.
Jezebel in TOUPA zawlneite athah lai a ka thilhih, TOUPA zawlneite lak a mi zakhat, sawmnga nga a kokhuk a, tanghou leh tui a ka vakdan ka toupa hon hilh lou uhia?
Tu in nang, kuan inla, ngai in, Elijah huai ah a-om hi, chi in na toupa va hilh in na chi mawk a; ama'n kei ahon that mahmah ding," achi hi.
Elijah in, "Ama ka dinna sepaihte' TOUPA ahin bang in ka gen ahi, tuni in akiang ah ka kihil ngeingei ding," achi hi.
Huchi in Ahab houpih ding in Obadiah akuan a, ahilhta a; huchi in Elijah mu ding in Ahab akuanta hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, Ahab in Elijah amuh in Ahab in akiang ah, "Nang na hi maw, Israelte buaisakpa?" achi hi.
Ama'n adawng a, "Israelte ka buaisak kei. Nang leh na pa inkote ahi ve abuaisak zaw; TOUPA thupiakte lehngatsan a, Baal na zuih zawkna ah.
Huchi in tu in Israel tengteng leh Baal zawlnei zali-le-sawmnga leh Asherah zawlnei, Jezebel dohkan a ankuang um zalite ka kiang ah Karmel tang ah va samkhawm in," achi hi.
Huchi in Ahab in Israel suan tengteng kiang ah mi asawl a, zawlneite Karmel tang ah asamkhawm hi.
Elijah in mipi tengteng ava naih a, "Vanglak a bang tan om ding na hi ua? TOUPA Pathian ahihleh, amah zui unla; Baal ahihleh amah zui un," achi hi. Mipite'n kam khat in leng adawng kei uh.
Huchi in Elijah in mipite kiang ah, "TOUPA zawlnei omsun kei kia ka hi a; Baal zawlneite bel mi zali-le-sawmnga ahi uh.

Huchi in bawngtal nih hong pia uhenla; amau bawngtal khat amau a tuam ding in tel uhenla, semnen uhenla, sing tung ah koih uhenla, anuai ah mei toh kei uhen. Ke'n leng bawngtal khat ka bawl sam dia, sing tung ah ka koih dia mei ahihleh ka toh kei ding.
Nou na pathiante min uh sam unla, ke'n TOUPA min ka sam ding. Huchi in mei a hon dawng Pathian pen Pathian hi hen," achi hi. Huchi in mi tengteng in, "Athugen ahoih hi,” chi in adawng uhi.
Elijah in Baal zawlneite kiang ah, "Nou bawngtal khat nou a tuam ding in tel unla, bawl masa un; nou na tam deuh ua; na pathiante min sam unla, himahleh anuai ah mei toh kei un," achi hi.

Bawngtal atan pen uh ala ua, abawl ua, "Baal aw, hon dawng in," chi in zingsang a pan sun tan in Baal min asam uh. Himahleh aw himhim a-om kei a, adawng leng a om sam kei a, maitam kibawl tung ah atawm uhi.

Sun lai in hichi ahong hi a, "Elijah in amau enghou in, kikou ngaih ve ua; pathian khat ahi ngal a. Midang houpih hiam, nungdelh nei lel hiam, khualzin ahihkeileh ihmu lel phawn teitei ngai houh hi in teh,” achi hi.
Huchi in angaih a ngaih in akikou ua, ahih zeldan bang un sisan pawt khop hial in temta in aki-atkeh ua, thilzum in akisun uhi.
Sun nung ahong hih in hichi ahong hi a, nitaklam kithoih hun tan in thu agen uhi. Himahleh aw hiam, dawngtu hiam limsaktu leng a-om kei.
Huchi in Elijah in mipi tengteng kiang ah, "Hong naih dih ua," achi hi. Huchi in mipi tengteng in ava naih uhi.
TOUPA maitam kichimsa abawlhoih a; na min Israel ahi ding, chi a TOUPA thu ana mupa Jakob tapate nam zah suang sawm-le-nih Elijah in ala hi.
Huai suangte in TOUPA min in maitam abawl a; maitam kim buhchi tehna nih takna ding atoukuak hi.
Sing akoih hoih sipsip a, bawngtal asemnen a, sing tung ah akoih hi. "Bel li tui in dimsak unla, halmang thillat leh sing buak un," achi hi.
Anihveina ding in, "Buak nawn un," achi a, abuak nawn uhi. Athumveina ding in, "Buak nawn un," achi a, abuak nawn uhi.
Huchi in tui maitam kim ah aluang zuazua a; tohkuak tui in adimta hi.

Nitaklam kithoih hun in hichi ahong hi a, zawlnei Elijah in ava naih a, "TOUPA Abraham, Isak leh Israel Pathian, nang Israel gam a Pathian na hihleh, kei na sikha ka hih, hiai tengteng nang thu a ka hih tuni in theihsak hi hen.
Hon ngaikhia in, aw TOUPA hon ngaikhia in, hiai mipite'n nang TOUPA Pathian na hi a, alungtang uh na heikik nawnta chih atheihna ding un," achi hi.
Huchi in TOUPA mei ahong kia a, halmang thillat, asing, asuang leh aleivui akangtum a, tohkuak a tui ahipkang hi.
Huchi in mipi tengteng in huai amuh un abokkhup ua, "TOUPA amah Pathian ahi, TOUPA amah Pathian ahi,” achi uh.
Elijah in akiang uah, "Baal zawlneite man unla, khat leng suaktasak kei un," achi hi. Huchi in aman ua, Elijah in Kishon lui ah apisuk a, huai ah amaute athat hi.
Elijah in Ahab kiang ah, "Paitou inla, ne in dawnta in; vuahpi zu ding husa a-om," achi hi.
heading: Khokheng Beina

paite: Ne leh dawn ding in Ahab apaitouta hi. Elijah bel Karmel tang vum ah apaitou a; lei ah akunsuk a, akhukte kikal ah amai aphual hi.
Asikha kiang ah, "Va paitou inla, tuipi lam va en mah dih!" achi hi. Ava paitou a, tuipi lam a-en a, "Bangmah a-om kei," achi hi. Ama'n, "Sagihvei kuan nawn in,” achi hi.

Asagihveina ah hichi ahong hi a, "Ngai in, tuipi a pan mihing khuttum chia lel meipi hong lengtou viaiviai," achi hi. Ama'n, "Va pai inla, Ahab kiang ah, na kangtalai bawl inla, paisukta in, vuah in ahon khum kha ding, chi in," achi hi.
Sawt lou nung in hichi ahong hi a, huih leh meipite in van adup keihkuih a, vuahpi tam petmah ahong zuta hi. Ahab kangtalai a tuang in Jezreel ah apaita hi.
TOUPA khut Elijah tung ah a-om a; apuan ateng a, Ahab ma ah Jezreel kholutna tan atai hi.
